line:story_prologue.text: Oh no! A big wind blew the star-snacks all over Picnic Island. Help Jammy and friends find them before the Picnic Party tonight!

line:story_finale.text: You found every star-snack! Jammy, Crisp, Niblet and Bloop say thank you. The Picnic Party can begin. Hooray for you!

line:beat_meadow.text: Hi, I'm Jammy! The star-snacks landed in the corn. Let's count and find them!

line:beat_cliffs.text: Crunch here! On Berry Beach, big and small numbers are hiding in the sand. Which one is bigger?

line:beat_beach.text: Boing! I'm Bloop. The wind blew snacks under the broccoli trees. Let's add them up!

line:beat_woods.text: Hee hee! I'm Niblet. The squirrels nibbled some snacks. Take away and see what's left!

line:beat_grove.text: I'm Vinnie. The pancake gate only opens for numbers that make ten together!

line:beat_town.text: Welcome to the cocoa volcano! Every number here is ten and some more.

line:beat_caves.text: Ooh, a mystery at Melon Bay! A number is missing. Can you find the hidden one?

line:beat_bay.text: The lolly lighthouse keeps lots of snacks. Time for bigger adding!

line:beat_volcano.text: So many apples! Take away big numbers to help the apple trees rest.

line:beat_lighthouse.text: The cookie caves echo even, odd, even, odd. This is the last area!

line:fr_poppy_hi.text: This is Poppy! Poppy is dreamy and cozy, and loves slow, happy hums.

line:fr_poppy_likes.text: Poppy likes naps, soft pillows, and humming sleepy songs.

line:fr_poppy_dislikes.text: Poppy doesn't like loud, beeping alarm clocks.

line:fr_poppy_food.text: Poppy's favorite food is warm milk with honey.

line:fr_poppy_tap3.text: Hum, hum, hum... la la la.

line:fr_clem_hi.text: This is Clem! Clem is sporty and brave, and loves to run, kick, and cheer.

line:fr_clem_likes.text: Clem likes running races, kicking balls, and cheering really loud!

line:fr_clem_dislikes.text: Clem doesn't like sitting still for too long.

line:fr_clem_food.text: Clem's favorite food is orange slices after a big game.

line:fr_dewdrop_hi.text: This is Dewdrop! Dewdrop is curious about everything, and asks why a lot.

line:fr_dewdrop_likes.text: Dewdrop likes rain puddles, bubbles, and finding things out.

line:fr_dewdrop_dislikes.text: Dewdrop doesn't like it when nobody answers her questions.

line:fr_dewdrop_food.text: Dewdrop's favorite food is cold, juicy watermelon.

line:fr_dewdrop_tap1.text: Why is the sky blue? Do you know?

line:fr_pickle_hi.text: This is Pickle! Pickle is a silly joker, and is always up to something fun.

line:fr_pickle_likes.text: Pickle likes jokes, funny faces, and playing hide and seek.

line:fr_pickle_dislikes.text: Pickle doesn't like being bored. Boring is so boring!

line:fr_pickle_food.text: Pickle's favorite food is crunchy pickles, of course!

line:fr_pickle_tap1.text: Knock knock! Who's there? Pickle! Hee hee!

line:fr_nova_hi.text: This is Nova! Nova is a dreamer and a stargazer, and hums little songs.

line:fr_nova_likes.text: Nova likes the stars, the moon, and making wishes.

line:fr_nova_dislikes.text: Nova doesn't like cloudy nights, because the stars hide.

line:fr_nova_food.text: Nova's favorite food is star-shaped cookies.

line:fr_nova_tap2.text: Did you make a wish today?

line:fr_nova_tap3.text: Look up! Can you see a star?

line:rc_0_0.text: Jammy has a red kite and a blue ball. Jammy flies the kite at the beach. What color is the kite?

line:rc_0_1.text: Peel has a little dog and a big cat. The dog likes to dig. The cat likes to nap. What does the dog like to do?

line:rc_0_2.text: Crunch ate a green grape. Then he gave a red grape to Bloop. Who got the red grape?

line:rc_0_3.text: Bloop was sad and tired. Then she got a new puppy! She smiled and hugged it. How did Bloop feel at the end?

line:rc_0_4.text: Dora was sleepy, but Crunch was not. His kite got stuck in a tall tree. He frowned and kicked a rock. How did Crunch feel?

line:rc_0_5.text: Gray clouds filled the sky. Niblet put on his boots and took his umbrella. What will happen next?

line:rc_0_6.text: The cat hid under the bed when it heard the loud thunder. Why did the cat hide?

line:rc_0_7.text: Dora and Jammy baked a cake for the picnic. They put on pink frosting. What did they bake?

line:rc_1_0.text: The wind was strong, so Bloop held her hat with both hands. She walked home slowly. Why did Bloop hold her hat?

line:rc_1_1.text: Petey found a shiny shell on the sand. He put it in his pocket to show his friends. Where did Petey put the shell?

line:rc_1_2.text: After school, Peel fed the fish. Then she did her homework at the kitchen table. What did Peel do first?

line:rc_1_3.text: Crunch was nervous and a little sleepy before the show. He sang his song, and everyone clapped and cheered. How did Crunch feel after the show?

line:rc_1_4.text: Bloop packed a towel, sunscreen and a shovel. She did not pack her school bag. Then she ran to the car. Where is Bloop probably going?

line:rc_1_5.text: First Crisp mixed the flour. Next he cracked two eggs. Last he put the pan in the oven. What did Crisp do after mixing the flour?

line:rc_1_6.text: Dora's plant was brown and dry. She gave it water every day. Soon it had green leaves. Why did the plant get green leaves?

line:rc_1_7.text: Jammy heard a knock at the door. Jammy opened it and saw Grandma holding a big gift with a bow. What will Jammy do next?

line:hom_24.text: Wave and say bye to Grandma.

line:hom_25.text: The bus went by my house.

line:hom_28.text: Mom and her son went to the park.

line:fr_apple_likes.text: Crisp's favorite thing is crunchy autumn walks.

line:fr_apple_dislikes.text: Crisp always says: Nice and crisp!

line:fr_apple_food.text: Crisp is a apple and loves a good picnic.

line:fr_corn_likes.text: Niblet's favorite thing is telling corny jokes.

line:fr_corn_food.text: Niblet is a corn on the cob and loves a good picnic.

line:fr_blueberry_dislikes.text: Bloop always says: Bloop bloop, I did it!

line:fr_mochi_hi.text: This is Dora Dumpling! Dora Dumpling is soft, cheerful and a little bit hungry.

line:fr_mochi_food.text: Dora Dumpling is a rice dumpling and loves a good picnic.

line:fr_banana_likes.text: Peel's favorite thing is bouncing on trampolines.

line:fr_banana_dislikes.text: Peel always says: Let's go bananas!

line:fr_banana_food.text: Peel is a banana and loves a good picnic.

line:fr_pear_hi.text: This is Petey Pear! Petey Pear is dreamy and gentle; thinks before he speaks.

line:fr_pear_likes.text: Petey Pear's favorite thing is cozy naps in the shade.

line:fr_pear_dislikes.text: Petey Pear always says: We make a great pear!

line:fr_pear_food.text: Petey Pear is a pear and loves a good picnic.

line:fr_carrot_hi.text: This is Crunch! Crunch is sporty and determined; never gives up.

line:fr_carrot_likes.text: Crunch's favorite thing is racing to the finish line.

line:fr_carrot_food.text: Crunch is a carrot and loves a good picnic.

line:fr_broccoli_hi.text: This is Brock! Brock is kind and strong, like a little tree.

line:fr_broccoli_likes.text: Brock's favorite thing is climbing real trees.

line:fr_broccoli_food.text: Brock is a broccoli and loves a good picnic.

line:fr_sushi_food.text: Umi is a sushi and loves a good picnic.

line:fr_taco_dislikes.text: Guac always says: Let's taco 'bout it!

line:fr_taco_food.text: Guac is a taco and loves a good picnic.

line:fr_pizza_hi.text: This is Slice! Slice is cool and confident; shares every slice.

line:fr_pizza_likes.text: Slice's favorite thing is pizza parties with friends.

line:fr_pizza_food.text: Slice is a pizza slice and loves a good picnic.

line:fr_pancake_hi.text: This is Maple! Maple is warm and cozy, like a sunny morning.

line:fr_pancake_likes.text: Maple's favorite thing is breakfast in bed.

line:fr_pancake_dislikes.text: Maple always says: Stack it up!

line:fr_pancake_food.text: Maple is a pancake stack and loves a good picnic.

line:fr_cupcake_hi.text: This is Sprinkles! Sprinkles is sweet and sparkly; loves to celebrate.

line:fr_cupcake_likes.text: Sprinkles's favorite thing is birthday candles.

line:fr_cupcake_dislikes.text: Sprinkles always says: Sprinkle some joy!

line:fr_cupcake_food.text: Sprinkles is a cupcake and loves a good picnic.

line:ow_kite_hint.text: Play on 3 days in one week to earn this!

line:ow_lollipop_hint.text: Finish Compare Berry Beach to earn this!

line:ow_explorer_hint.text: Finish Add-Up Broccoli Woods to earn this!

line:ow_trophy_hint.text: Win 3 friend challenges with no oopsies to earn this!

line:ow_snorkel_hint.text: Finish Mystery Melon Bay to earn this!

line:ow_conductor_hint.text: Meet your weekly goal in 5 weeks to earn this!

line:ow_teddy_hint.text: Play on 25 different days to earn this!

line:ow_bubbles_hint.text: Get 3 stars on both stops of 2 island areas to earn this!

line:ow_bee_hint.text: Get 3 stars on both stops of Take-Away Apple Grove to earn this!

line:ow_net_hint.text: Finish Take-Away Apple Grove and meet your weekly goal in 5 weeks to earn this!

line:ow_headlamp_hint.text: Finish Even-Odd Cookie Caves and master 4 skills to earn this!

line:ow_dino_hint.text: Get 3 stars on both stops of Teen Cocoa Volcano to earn this!

line:ow_telescope_hint.text: Get 3 stars on both stops of Big Sum Lolly Lighthouse to earn this!

line:ow_umbrella_hint.text: Meet your weekly goal in 6 weeks to earn this!

line:ow_rainhat_hint.text: Meet your weekly goal in 8 weeks to earn this!

line:ow_ukulele_hint.text: Meet your weekly goal in 10 weeks to earn this!

line:ow_flag_hint.text: Collect 900 stars and meet your weekly goal in 6 weeks to earn this!

line:ow_golden_basket_hint.text: Finish the whole Picnic Island story to earn this!

line:munch_ready_touch.text: Ready? Tap a square to walk, and tap your friend to munch. Tap Play!

line:bb_intro_howto.text: Pick your swing, then answer the pitch! Harder questions hit farther!

line:bb_one_player_sub.text: Three innings. Harder questions hit farther!

line:err_count_dots.text: Touch each dot and count them. One, two, three!

line:err_count_back.text: Start from the big number, then count back.

line:err_make_ten.text: How many more make ten? Count up to ten on your fingers.

line:err_number_line.text: Say the numbers in order. Which one is missing?

line:pt_stop.text: Great stopping point! You played so well today. Time to rest.

line:pt_bye.text: Bye bye! See you next time!

line:pt_stretch.text: Time for a stretch! Reach up high, wiggle your fingers, and take a big breath.
